patterns.description: Customers frequently report issues with the quality of the food, indicating inconsistency or general dissatisfaction with dishes.
A notable number of reviews mention negative or unhelpful interactions with staff members.
Some customers find the restaurant's ambience to be unpleasant or not up to expectations.
A few reviews indicate that customers perceive the pricing to be too high for the value received.

root_causes.cause: Lack of consistent quality control in the kitchen, issues with ingredient sourcing, or inadequate training for kitchen staff.
Insufficient staff training in customer service, low staff morale, or inadequate management oversight of front-of-house operations.
Outdated decor, poor maintenance, excessive noise levels, or lack of attention to creating a comfortable dining environment.
Pricing strategy not aligned with the perceived value of the food and overall dining experience, or lack of transparency in pricing.
